verdicts.reason: A: the Lisbon card is shrunk to a tiny card with unreadable text while the Marrakech and Reykjavik cards are large, so the three peer cards are inconsistent and misaligned. The headline leaves 'out' orphaned on its own line, and the subtitle is jammed against the CTA at the bottom. B: all three cards are tiny, with unreadable city names and 'from' labels. They are out of order (Reykjavik, Lisbon, Marrakech) and scattered between the subtitle and the CTA, which breaks grouping and reading order.
